title: Crush & Shatter
description: An Epic Fight addon that adds Clubs, Hammers, and Maces
body:
**Crush & Shatter** is an addon for Epic Fight that expands the weapon roster with three new heavy weapon classes, each featuring custom movesets dedicated to the Epic Fight combat framework.

---

>  **This mod requires Epic Fight to function. It will not work without it.**

---

##  Weapons

- **Clubs** — A primitive yet powerful weapon, delivering heavy blows with a straightforward moveset.
- **Hammers** — Slow, weighty, and devastating. Built for players who prefer raw impact over speed.
- **Maces** — A balance of weight and agility, offering a unique combat style distinct from swords.

---

##  Requirements

- **Epic Fight** — Required

---
